_meta.description: Australian-units reference library for the A to E MCQ bank. Each category carries a population tag so a paediatric panel is never shown under an adult question.
_meta.units_policy: SI units throughout (mmol/L, micromol/L, g/L, x10^9/L, pmol/L, nmol/L). pCO2/pO2 in both kPa and mmHg where relevant. The unit lives in `units`, never repeated inside `value`.
